Kanban board

A DOM-first board sample with drag-and-drop cards, provider state, and JSON export.

Backlog → In progress → Review → Done

Provider notes

The board reads from a plain JSON provider, renders four lanes, and updates the card status in place when you drop a card into a new column.

Sample behavior

Cards can be dragged between columns. The current state is exportable as JSON, so the host can persist or diff the board without a canvas layer.
